title: THE AMAZING DIGITAL PACK
description: This pack adds universe of TADC
body:
**_The Amazing Digital Circus Pack_**

A fun texture pack that changes all Minecraft beds.

Every wool color corresponds to a different character from the show. Fully compatible with multiplayer servers - let your friends wake up face-to-face with Kinger or Zooble! Make your Minecraft nights a whole lot more colorful (and a little more digital).

<details>
<summary>1.0</summary>
  
  ![AMAZING BEDS](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/523b6a249943d6cb0ac53f1b1a2997732ac00962_0.webp)
- Each bed color is replaced with a different character: Pomni, Jax, Ragatha, Caine, Bubble, and more!

</details>
